job: Work through what waits for a decision, one case at a time, beside the list.
purpose: A pattern of a grouped list and the case it opens. Items show a kind tile, a two-line title, who asked and how long it waited. Picking one marks it current, shows its case and fires fd:select. Narrower than a list plus a readable case, it shows one at a time with a Queue button back. With fd-commit data-fd-hold-in="toast", a committed case leaves at once while its toast counts down, and Undo returns it.
useWhen: Several requests or agent proposals wait for one person: credits, hosts, access, changes.
A reviewer moves through items and should not lose their place.

avoidWhen.when: The items are records to compare, sort or act on in bulk.
One decision on a page of its own, reached from a link.

states.name: list or case
states.how: data-view="list|case" on fd-queue, which a narrow queue reads

states.name: empty
states.how: wrap it in fd-states and show data-when="empty" when removeItem returns null

variants.useWhen: On fd-queue-age: the wait is close to a deadline.
